u5.label: Under-five mortality
u5.note: Probability of death before age five, expressed per 1,000 live births. Modelled estimates; uncertainty intervals are not included in this extract.

neonatal.label: Neonatal mortality
neonatal.note: Death during the first 28 days of life, per 1,000 live births. Modelled estimates; this is distinct from infant mortality.

infant.label: Infant mortality
infant.note: Death before the first birthday, per 1,000 live births. The under-five and neonatal SDG thresholds are not applied to this series.

maternal.label: Maternal mortality
maternal.note: Maternal deaths during pregnancy or within 42 days of termination, per 100,000 live births. Modelled estimates; uncertainty intervals are not included. The global SDG benchmark is not a country-specific pass/fail target.

life.label: Life expectancy at birth
life.note: Expected years of life under the mortality rates of the stated year. This is a population outcome, not the observed lifespan of a birth cohort.

ncd.label: Premature NCD mortality
ncd.note: Probability of dying between exact ages 30 and 70 from cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes or chronic respiratory disease. This is not the share of all deaths due to NCDs.
ncd.producer: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory Data Repository (http://apps.who.int/ghodata/)., World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://www.who.int/data/gho

tb.label: Tuberculosis incidence
tb.note: Estimated new and relapse tuberculosis cases in a year per 100,000 population. Case notifications and case detection are different measures.
tb.producer: Global Tuberculosis Report, World Health Organization (WHO)

hiv.label: HIV incidence, ages 15–49
hiv.note: New HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected people aged 15–49. This subset is not the full all-age SDG series or the historical MDG prevalence indicator.
hiv.producer: UNAIDS estimates, Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS), uri: https://aidsinfo.unaids.org/, publisher: UNAIDS, date accessed: 2025-08-27, date published: 2025-07

malaria.label: Malaria incidence
malaria.note: Estimated cases per 1,000 people at risk of malaria. A missing country value does not mean zero cases or elimination.
malaria.producer: Global Health Observatory Data Repository/World Health Statistics, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: http://apps.who.int/ghodata/

stunting.label: Child stunting
stunting.note: Height-for-age more than two standard deviations below the child growth reference. Survey years are sparse; stunting is not underweight.

underweight.label: Child underweight
underweight.note: Weight-for-age more than two standard deviations below the child growth reference. No substitution of stunting or wasting for underweight.

births.label: Skilled attendance at birth
births.note: Births attended by trained health personnel. Attendance measures contact with services, not quality or effective coverage.

dtp.label: DTP3 immunization
dtp.note: Children receiving three doses of diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis vaccine. One vaccine tracer does not represent coverage of all nationally recommended vaccines.
dtp.producer:
World Health Organization (WHO), uri: http://www.who.int/immunization/monitoring_surveillance/en/;
UN Children's Fund (UNICEF)

measles.label: Measles immunization
measles.note: Children receiving at least one dose of measles-containing vaccine. This is not the second-dose measles tracer used in SDG vaccine reporting.
measles.producer:
World Health Organization (WHO), uri: http://www.who.int/immunization/monitoring_surveillance/en/;
UN Children's Fund (UNICEF), uri: https://data.unicef.org/topic/child-health/immunization/

anc.label: Antenatal care, at least one visit
anc.note: At least one pregnancy-related contact with skilled health personnel. This series does not measure four visits, eight contacts or quality of care.

fp.label: Family planning needs met
fp.note: Demand satisfied with modern methods among married women aged 15–49. The denominator is narrower than the all-women SDG indicator.
fp.producer: Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS), uri: FP_NADM_W_PDM, date accessed: 2026-06-15

tb_success.label: TB treatment success
tb_success.note: Success among registered new TB cases, or new and relapse cases in some countries. Cohort definitions can vary; people not diagnosed or registered are excluded.
tb_success.producer: Global Tuberculosis Report, World Health Organization (WHO)

art.label: HIV treatment coverage
art.note: People living with HIV receiving antiretroviral therapy. The historical MDG denominator was people with advanced HIV infection; the two measures are not interchangeable.
art.producer: UNAIDS estimates, Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS), uri: https://aidsinfo.unaids.org/, publisher: UNAIDS, date accessed: 2025-08-27, date published: 2025-07

water.label: Safely managed drinking water
water.note: Water from an improved source that is accessible on premises, available when needed and free from contamination. This is stricter than the MDG improved-source definition.
water.producer:
WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: washdata.org, note: Aggregate data by groups are computed based on the groupings for the World Bank fiscal year in which the data was released by the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene., publisher: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (washdata.org), date accessed: 2025-09-30, date published: 2025-08-25;
UN Children's Fund (UNICEF), uri: washdata.org, note: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene

sanitation.label: Safely managed sanitation
sanitation.note: Improved, non-shared sanitation with excreta safely disposed of or treated. Handwashing is a separate component of SDG 6.2.1; this is stricter than the MDG improved-sanitation definition.
sanitation.producer:
WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: washdata.org, note: Aggregate data by groups are computed based on the groupings for the World Bank fiscal year in which the data was released by the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene., publisher: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (washdata.org), date accessed: 2025-09-30, date published: 2025-08-25;
UN Children's Fund (UNICEF), uri: washdata.org, note: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene

adolescent.label: Adolescent birth rate, ages 15–19
adolescent.note: Live births per 1,000 women aged 15–19. The additional SDG age group 10–14 is not covered by this series.
adolescent.producer: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

uhc.label: UHC service coverage index
uhc.note: Revised 2025 service coverage index, using the full re-estimated time series. This is a tracer-based index, not the percentage of people with insurance or effective coverage. It is not spliced to the archived World Bank series.
uhc.producer: World Health Organization and World Bank
uhc.api_url: https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/UHC_INDEX_REPORTED?$filter=SpatialDimType eq 'COUNTRY' and Dim1 eq null and Dim2 eq null

hardship.label: Financial hardship from health spending
hardship.note: People with positive out-of-pocket health spending exceeding 40% of the household discretionary budget, net of the societal poverty line. Survey-year estimates; the revised definition is not comparable with the older 10% or 25% of total-budget indicators. Zero spending can reflect unmet need rather than protection.
hardship.producer: World Health Organization and World Bank
